name: Fermi America HyperGrid lateral (Energy Transfer)
monitor_reason: no off-site pipeline length or route found; it may be only a meter tap on Energy Transfer's existing line south of the campus plus in-fence piping, which is out of scope
researcher_notes: No existing row matches. Panhandle Eastern and ONEOK WesTex are nearby systems but neither is this connection. A trade press article from October 2025 says Fermi will connect to an Energy Transfer pipeline just south of its Amarillo campus, with service expected in the first quarter of 2026. An Energy Daley article from November 2025 says a new lateral is needed. Neither gives a length, route, diameter or regulator filing. The only length found is about 4.6 miles of pipe on the campus itself, which is in-fence and out of scope. Searches for a Texas Railroad Commission filing and an off-site length found nothing. A site-wide data center tie is stated, but without a concrete off-site pipeline this stays on the watch list. Revisit if Energy Transfer or the Railroad Commission shows an off-site segment.
